title: Berlin Spy Museum - Quick Summary
items: **Choose the museum for activity, not just the subject.** The useful question is whether your group wants codes, devices and a laser-maze-style experience, rather than another quiet set of labels.
**Let Potsdamer Platz be the decision point.** The museum is at Leipziger Platz, so use the area to decide between an indoor stop, a real historic site or simply the next neighbourhood move.
**Give the visit a real boundary.** The museum recommends age eight and up and suggests 1.5–2 hours for children; check the current official visitor details for your group before travel.

**Do not make it carry all of Berlin’s history.** A playful spy experience and a real encounter with divided-city history are different kinds of visit. Add an actual site when history is your main reason.
Use the Berlin Spy Museum Mission Match to inspect the experience you want before the ticket becomes an automatic Potsdamer Platz decision.
